book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Luka

content: Yesu ahyoka
Jumapili lukela pachibhombu, akambomba bhala bhakapiti kulitengeli, koni bhatoghwi manungilu ghabhalenganakile.
Bhakalihimani liganga la kuyekalela litengeli lela likangakiki kutali na litengele.
Bhela bhakajingi mulitengeli, nambu ngachebhajiweni hyegha jaka Bambo Yesu.
Pabhakabhi bhaholale panani ja lilobhi leniheli, palapala bhandu bhabhele bhabhaweti ingobhu ihuhu kupukupu bhakajemiki pambipi nabhu.
Akambomba bhala bhakajowipi namaa na kujinama mbaka pahi. Nambu bhandu bhala bhakabhapwaghile, “Bho, magambu kiki mundonda joayokiki pachilanda ja bhabhawile?
Yesu ngacheabhi pambane, ahyokike! Nkombuka moakampwaghile chikahi paakabhi ku Galilaya.
Akumpwaghi kubha, ‘Mwana waka Mundu anabhumpelaka mu mabhoku gha bhana mahoku, na kuwambakika punsalaba, nambu lichobha la katatu ayiyokaje.’ ”
Panihapa akambomba bhala bhakakombwiki malobhi ghaka Yesu.
Bhakakelawiki kuhuma kulitengeli, na bhakabhapwaghi mambu ghanihagha bhabhulwa bhaki komi na jumu bhala, na kwa bhahemba bhangi bhokapi bhaka Yesu.
Akambomba bhabhapwaghika mambu ghanihagha kwa mitumi bhaka Yesu bhakabhi nde, Malia Magidalena, na Yoana, na Malia mabhu waka Yakobo, na akambomba bhangi bhabhakabhi papamu nabhu.
Nambu mitumi bhaka Yesu bhakaghatohi mambu ghanihagha kubha ngati gha upuhe, na bhela ngachebhahobhalile.

Nambu Petulu akajemiki, na kukembela imbelu mbaka kulitengeli. Paakahikiki, akajinimi na kulingali mkati, akaiweni pe sanda. Bhela akabhujiki kunyumba koni akangacha kwa ndandi ja mambu ghaghapitalile.
Kujenda ku Emau
Lichobha lelalela, bhabhulwa bhabhele bhaka Yesu bhakabhi bhajenda ku chijiji chimu chekilowakeka Emau, chechikabhi utali wa kilometa komi na moja kuhuma ku Yelusalemu.
Bhakabhi bhalongale panani ja mambu ghokapi ghaghapitalile.
Pabhakabhi bhalongale na kulaluwana, Yesu mweni akabhaheghali pambipi na kulongana nabhu.
Bhakumbweni nambu ngachebhumanye.
Yesu akabhalalukile, “Bho, ndongale kiki koni njenda?” Na bhombi bhakajemiki na kutumbala chinunu, koni bhakalangiya pamihu jabhu kubha bhabhi na huzuni.
Jumu wabhu pachilanda ja bhandu bhanihabha, joalowakika Kileopa, akamuyangike, “Bho, wehapa le ungeni kanjika jaku ku Yelusalemu, wangakumanya mambu ghaghapitali konihoku machobha ghane?”

Jombi akabhalalukile, “Mambu bhole?” Bhombi bhakamuyangiki, “Mambu ghaghumpitali Yesu wa ku Nazaleti. Mundu hoju akabhi mlota waka Chapanga joakabhi na uwezu wa kuhenga na kubhola palongi jaka Chapanga na palongi ja bhandu bhokapi.
Bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa na bhatawala bhitu bhakumbohiki nahuli atemuliwa kupotela, na bhombi bhakunhwambiki punsalaba.
Tepani tukahobhali kubha jombi nde joabhakombulaje bhandu bha Izilaeli. Nambu lalenu nde lichobha la katatu kutumbu mambu ghanihagha paghahengakike.
Bhelabhela akambomba bhangi kuhuma mulipogha litu bhatehi kutukangacha. Bhakapiti kulitengeli lukela pachibhombu,
nambu ngachebhakajiweni hyegha jaki. Bhela bhakakelawiki na kutupwaghi kubha bhakapitaliwi na bhatumika bha kunani kwaka Chapanga na kubhapwaghi kubha Yesu abhi mwome.
Bhakumu bhitu bhakapiti kulitengeli, na kughahimani mambu ghokapi chakaka ngati mobhapwaghila akambomba bhala, nambu jombi ngachebhumbwene.”
Bhela Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Bho, mbona mbi mwang'ang'a bhenibhela, na mitima jinu jinonwopi kuhobhalela malobhi ghokapi ghaghalongaliki na bhalota bhaka Chapanga?
Bho, ngachekumpaliki Kristo kung'ahakika, na bhela kujingi mu ulumbalilu waki?”
Akabhapwaghi mambu ghokapi ghaghumpalika jombi mu Malembu Mahuhu ghokapi, kutumbu itabu yokapi yaka Musa na kujendale mu itabhu yokapi ya bhalota bhokapi bhaka Chapanga.
Pabhakaheghali pambipi na chijiji chebhapita chela, Yesu akalengiki kubha ngati ajendale na mwanja,
nambu bhombi bhakumpembali namaa, bhakapwaghaje, “Utama papamu na tepani, maghambu kutenda kupilila, na ikilu kuheghalela.” Bhela akapiti na kutama papamu nabhu.
Paakatami kula chilebhi papamu nabhu, akatoliki libumunda, akalipengalili, akalihekiti, na kubhapekeha.
Palapala mihu ghabhu ghakahoghuliwi, bhakummanye, nambu jombi akahobhiki pamihu jabhu.
Bhela bhakapwaghanile, “Bho, mitima jitu le ngachejibhelala mkati jitu paakabhi atuyekulila Malembu Mahuhu kwindela kola?”
Palapala bhakabhokiki na kukelabhuka ku Yelusalemu. Konikola bhakabhaketani mitumi komi na jumu bhala bhalibhongini papamu, bhakabya na bhandu bhangi bhabhakabhili papamu nabhu,
bhakapwaghaje, “Chakaka Bambo ayokike, na akumpitali Simoni.”
Bhela bhabhulwa bhabheli bhala bhakabhalandi mambu ghala ghaghapatiki mwindela, na ntundu mobhakummanyi paakabhi aheketa libumunda.
Yesu abhapitali bhabhulwa bhaki
Pabhakabhi bhapwaghanila ghanihagha, palapala Yesu mweni akajemiki pachilanda jabhu, na kubhapwaghila, “Lukwali lukubha na mwehapa.”
Bhakakenyamwiki na kujoghopa namaa, bhakaholakya pangi bhaweni lihoka.
Nambu jombi akabhapwaghile, “Bho, mbona mlagha? Bho, mbona nkubha na choghohi mu mitima jinu?
Ndingalya mabhoku na magholu ghangu, kubha nde nepani namwete. Mbapiya mbonaje, maghambu lihoka ngachelibhi na hyegha wala ihupa ngati mommone nepane.”
Paakajomwi kulonge ghanighala, akabhalangi mabhoku na magholu ghaki.
Bhombi pabhakabhi bhakona ngakuhobhalela, kwa ndandi ja chiheku na kukangacha, Yesu akabhalalukile, “Bho, mbi na chilebhi chokapi chela pambane?”
Bhakumpeki chipandi cha homba ja kujocha.
Akachitoliki, akalili koni bhokapi bhakabya bhumbona.

Bhela akabhapwaghile, “Aghagha nde mambu ghanakumpwaghili chikahi panakabhi nakona papamu na mwehapa: Kubha ipalika ghapitalya mambu ghokapi ghaghalembakiki panani jangu mu Shelia yaka Musa, na mu Malembu gha bhalota bhaka Chapanga na mu Chitabu cha Zabuli.”
Panihapa akabhayekwi malangu ghabhu nahuli bhapata kumanya Malembu Mahuhu.
Akabhapwaghile, “Ilembakiki mu Malembu Mahuhu kubha Kristo aying'ahakika na kuyoka lichobha la katatu.
Bhandu bhokapi bhapalika kutangaziwa kwa lihina laki bhang'anambukaje na kughaleka mahoku ghabhu, na Chapanga anaabhalekakya mahoku ghabhu, kutumbula ku Yelusalemu na kwa inchi yokapi.
Mabhanganya nde momwapwaghila bhandu kubha mambu ghokapi ghaghapitalili hagha nde gha chakaka.
Nepani namweti ananundetila jola Atati wangu joapwaghiki anaantumaje. Nambu mwenga ndendalya moni mu Yelusalemu, mbaka pamwijopalya makili ghala ghaghahuma kunani kumahunde.”
Yesu akelabhuka kujenda kunani kumahunde
Bhela akabhalongwi kunja ja muchi wa Yelusalemu mbaka ku Besania, akajinwi mabhoku ghaki na kubhapengalela.
Paakabhi abhapengalela, akabhalekiki, na kutolakeka kujenda kunani kumahunde.
Bhombi bhakunjojabhili, na panihapa bhakakelawiki ku Yelusalemu bhakabya na chiheku nakanopi.
Machobha ghokapi bhakajendali kutama pa Nyumba jaka Chapanga koni bhakundumbalya Chapanga. Amina.
